label: Slate interface-theme background tile: squared block wall
source_note: SpriteCook's native output is 200 by 200 pixels at every export setting; this is the full-size generation.
presentation_contract: Repeated in both axes without stretching behind menu-style screens for the four Slate interface themes, under a 45% wash of the backdrop colour and an edge vignette. Also laid faintly, at the player's panel-texture strength (10% by default), over framed panels and the play screen's own surfaces in both HUD layouts.
